@.what: Translator context for every key of the page catalogs: where the words show, tone, values, room at 390 px, origins, and the source hash (src) of the 繁體中文 text the context describes.

flags.name-inside: A value is the duck's or a person's name: data, shown as it is.
flags.name-data: This is a name (data): it is never translated.
flags.duck-sound: The duck's own sound: use your language's duckling onomatopoeia, 1–4 characters, one line.
flags.parser-input: The text-command box / memory query understands 繁體中文 only: this is offered as an example; see docs/i18n.md (open decision).
flags.technical-terms: Keep product and program names as they are (Duck Core, Microduck, robotd, MuJoCo, ToF, SHA-256, --live …).
flags.technical-detail-inside: A value is program words (often English): shown as they are.
flags.html:
Keep the HTML tags (, ,
, ) exactly; translate only the words between them.
flags.plural: A number counts something here: use your language's plural forms ({n, plural, one {…} other {…}}) where it has them.
flags.number-format: A decimal number: keep its {x, number, …} format (your language's decimal mark is automatic).
flags.units: Metric units: 公尺 = m, 公分 = cm, 公尺/秒 = m/s; ° and % stay.
flags.date-time: A date or time value: times are 24-hour HH:MM everywhere.
flags.stub-only: Shown only on the page check with made-up numbers (--neuro-stub).
flags.in-progress: From a module another workflow was still writing: its words may still change.
flags.incoming: From a new module that is not on the page yet: its words may still change.
flags.tight-390: One line that does not wrap on a 390 px phone: keep it short.
flags.format-only: No words of its own: only the order of the values and punctuation. Keep all values; adjust order and punctuation to your language.
flags.fragment: A piece of a longer sentence (see where/origins): translate so it fits into it.
flags.inline-choice: A value picks one of a few words (each is its own key).
flags.key-is-text: The code also uses these words as a data key today (see the integration plan): the integrator fixes that before this text is translated on the page.
flags.logic-coupled: The code compares these words today (see the integration plan): the integrator fixes that before this text is translated on the page.
flags.en-source: The text is English today (no 繁體中文 source yet).
flags.frozen: Made by the frozen engine 蛋黃 runs on (matched back at the API boundary).
flags.event-payload: These words are stored in the duck's event chain; the page translates them on the way out.
flags.never-seen: Rare: not seen in the recorded sessions.
flags.server-text-inside: A value is other catalog words (translated by their own key).
flags.a11y: Screen-reader text (aria-label / alt): short and plain.
flags.css-content: Drawn by CSS content: the integrator moves it into the page's markup.

@.default_tone: plain words for the family (白話), third person for the duck (牠) (entries without a tone)

fields.where: where the words show on the page (or the API field that carries them)
fields.kind: static (HTML) | attr (tooltip / aria / placeholder) | canvas (3D/2D stage overlays) | template (page script) | server (Python text sent to the page) | format
fields.params: each {value}: its type and the code that fills it
fields.room: how much fits on a 390 px phone: px wide, one_line (never wraps), latin / cjk letters per line
fields.same_words_as: other keys with exactly the same 繁體中文 (translate alike unless the place needs otherwise)
fields.origins: inventory id, tree, file:line and code of every place the words come from
fields.src: fingerprint of the 繁體中文 text this context describes (a changed text under an old key fails the tests)
fields.zh_len: characters of the 繁體中文 words (values left out)
fields.v4_1_names: the frozen and the current engine name a value differently: the boundary renames by position

neuro.skill.doing.abort.where: what the body is doing: handing back to the walking network

neuro.skill.doing.any.where: what the body is doing: a whole-body move (no name)

neuro.skill.doing.bow.where: what the body is doing: a bow

neuro.skill.doing.freeze.where: what the body is doing: crouch and freeze

neuro.skill.doing.hop_back.where: what the body is doing: back-steps

neuro.skill.doing.hop_over.where: what the body is doing: stepping over a low strip

neuro.skill.doing.lie.where: what the body is doing: lying low

neuro.skill.doing.march.where: what the body is doing: marching in place

neuro.skill.doing.release.where: what the body is doing: rising from a crouch

neuro.skill.doing.release_bow.where: what the body is doing: getting up from lying low

neuro.skill.doing.shake.where: what the body is doing: shaking off

neuro.skill.doing.startle.where: what the body is doing: whole-body startle

neuro.skill.doing.step_down.where: what the body is doing: stepping down off a mat

neuro.skill.doing.step_up.where: what the body is doing: stepping up onto a mat

neuro.skill.doing.stretch_sit.where: what the body is doing: seated stretch

neuro.skill.doing.stretch_tall.where: what the body is doing: standing stretch

neuro.skill.doing.turn.where: what the body is doing: turning on the spot

neuro.skill.judge.back.where: what the body measurably did: stepped back; cm

neuro.skill.judge.back_turned.where: what the body measurably did: turned while backing

neuro.skill.judge.crouch.where: what the body measurably did: crouched; cm = how low, timing = the words above

neuro.skill.judge.done.where: the body line for a reflex answered by a whole-body move: done

neuro.skill.judge.neck_back.where: what the body measurably did: neck pulled back; deg = degrees

neuro.skill.judge.neck_short.where: what the body measurably did: neck pulled back too little

neuro.skill.judge.not_done.where: the body line: it was not done

neuro.skill.judge.not_graded.where: the body line for a reflex window in which a whole-body move ran (not graded)

neuro.skill.judge.not_stopped.where: what the body measurably did: did not stop at once

neuro.skill.judge.partial.where: the body line: only part of it was done

neuro.skill.judge.shake.where: what the body measurably did: head swing only

neuro.skill.judge.shake_body.where: what the body measurably did: shook; deg = head, body = trunk swing

neuro.skill.judge.stopped.where: what the body measurably did: stopped walking; s = seconds

neuro.skill.judge.stretch.where: what the body measurably did: rose in a stretch

neuro.skill.judge.timing.where: how soon after the scare the body moved; s = seconds

neuro.skill.judge.trunk_short.where: what the body measurably did: the trunk dropped too little

neuro.skill.judge.two_crouches.where: what the body measurably did: crouched, rose, crouched again

neuro.skill.judge.unmade.where: a note: the brain's named head turn is not made during a whole-body move

neuro.skill.judge.yaw_left.where: a part of a reflex the brain named: head turn left

neuro.skill.judge.yaw_right.where: a part of a reflex the brain named: head turn right

neuro.skill.posture.sit.where: a posture in a refusal: sitting

neuro.skill.posture.stand.where: a posture in a refusal: standing

neuro.skill.posture.walk.where: a posture in a refusal: walking

neuro.skill.reason.busy.where: why a trained move was refused: another move runs

neuro.skill.reason.continue.where: the guard's answer when a freeze takes over a startle's crouch

neuro.skill.reason.docked.where: why a trained move was refused: in the nest

neuro.skill.reason.fallen.where: why a trained move was refused: fallen

neuro.skill.reason.gap.where: why a trained move was refused: done a moment ago

neuro.skill.reason.held.where: why a trained move was refused: held in a hand

neuro.skill.reason.hold.where: the guard's answer while a held crouch goes on

neuro.skill.reason.hourly.where: why a trained move was refused: too often this hour

neuro.skill.reason.nothing.where: why a trained move was refused: nothing to end

neuro.skill.reason.ok.where: the guard's answer when a trained move may start

neuro.skill.reason.posture.where: why a trained move was refused: posture; now = the duck's posture, need = the postures it was tested in

neuro.skill.reason.posture_any.where: why a trained move was refused: posture (no detail)

neuro.skill.reason.settle.where: why a trained move was refused: just stood up or stopped

neuro.skill.reason.speed.where: why a trained move was refused: walking too fast

neuro.skill.reason.tilt.where: why a trained move was refused: the body is tilted

neuro.skill.reason.total.where: why a trained move was refused: enough whole-body moves this hour

neuro.skill.reason.unknown.where: why a trained move was refused: this body does not have it
